versions.changelog: Security fix: replaced npx -y tsx with native node .mjs scripts. Declared CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY credential in manifest.

Version 1.0.2 of crazyrouter-stt

- No file changes detected in this version.
- Functionality and usage remain the same as the previous release.

- Updated API key check to provide clearer feedback and guidance for setting up CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY.
- Changed usage examples to use tsx instead of bun for running scripts.

Initial release of crazyrouter-stt — Speech-to-text transcription via the Crazyrouter API (OpenAI Whisper):

- Transcribe audio and video files (mp3, mp4, wav, m4a, webm) to text.
- Option to save transcripts to a file or output to stdout.
- Support for providing language hints and on-the-fly translation to English.
- Requires configuration of a Crazyrouter API key.
- Simple command-line usage with configurable options for input, output, language, and model.
